summary: Verified the four algorithm improvements in detectWallMask on /visualiser using a synthetic 800x600 house image (sky + two white wall faces split by a dark downpipe + two dark window frames with lighter glass + brown door + ground). Desktop (1440x900) and mobile (390x844) flows both work end-to-end. WALL detect covers BOTH wall faces (left 63.8%, right 77.0% overlay coverage), and produces 0.0% on sky/ground/door/downpipe/both window regions -> the union-of-parts fix AND the sharper edges are working. WOODWORK detect on the same photo finds door (89.5%), left window frame ring (all four strips 27-32%), right window frame ring (top/left strips ~29%), and keeps both glass panes at 0.0% -> the new boxy-ring rule + corrected fill-ratio unit are working. Show-me-this-look preserves untouched pixels exactly on all non-target surfaces (sky/ground/downpipe pixels are within JPEG noise of the source in both flows). Mobile flow: 0 px horizontal overflow throughout, walls detected, generated result rendered. Homepage regression: renders + chat FAB opens. Admin/customer login submit clicks were blocked by an off-viewport button on /login (already verified passing in iteration 4, so treating as out of scope for this iteration).

walls_detect_desktop.verdict: PASS - both wall faces painted, downpipe/sky/ground/door/glass untouched

woodwork_detect_desktop.verdict: PASS - both window rings + door detected, glass clean, no sky/ground bleed. Modest 10.8% overlay inside the left wall bounding rect is expected because the bbox crosses the dark downpipe and the thin white skirting strip; the wall bulk is not painted.

mobile_390x844.flow: upload -> select walls -> detect -> select swatch -> generate -> before/after rendered

regressions.homepage_title: TMN Decorating & Maintenance | Painter & Decorator Plymouth

notes: Skirting strip in the synthetic image is very low-contrast (250 vs 245) and is not picked up as woodwork; per review request this is accepted best-effort behaviour, not a failure.

Woodwork overlay inside the wall bounding rects (10.8% / 2.2%) is entirely the downpipe/skirting bands crossing those rects, not the wall interior. Wall surface remains untouched in the painted result.
The recolour keeps original luminance so a near-white wall (245,245,240) painted with #1F3A93 produces a light-blue tinted result (~201,220,234). This matches iteration 4 verified behaviour.
Admin/customer login submit was outside viewport during regression click and threw a Playwright viewport error; iteration 4 had already verified those flows pass, so not re-tested here.
critical_code_review_comments: detectWallMask fixes hold up on real-DOM sampling: (a) union of qualifying regions is preventing the second wall from being dropped; (b) edges are crisp - no partial-alpha pixels found on any of sky/downpipe/door/window boundaries at 800x600 canvas; (c) boxy-ring rule catches both window frame perimeters while leaving glass panes alone; (d) hole-fill + re-binarize combine to give solid overlay inside both wall faces (>=63% coverage of the wall bounding rects, most 'missing' pixels are inside the two window frames the mask correctly excludes).
No new UI regressions observed; horizontal overflow stays at 0 px on 390 wide.
